description: Comment where people will see it, under the name Convexity: reply in a thread (reply_to: a comment's id from list_comments), or start one on a project file (file, with spot for a page, a sheet range, a row or a quoted passage) or on a value in the open model (component and attribute, and scenario when it is about one). Comment only when asked to, or to flag something a person should check.

reply_to.description: A comment id: the reply goes in its thread.

scenario.description: Scenario name; absent or "base" for the base network.

spot.description: Where in the file: {page} for a PDF, {sheet, range} for a spreadsheet ("C4:D6"), {row, column} for a CSV, {quote} for a passage of text.

name: add_comment
